top_categories.workout_context: 79 miles on brutal paved rollers with wine valley stunners burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.

Road-specific control matters at GFNY Chile. Practice on brutal paved rollers with wine valley stunners: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 79 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Chile's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
76ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At GFNY Chile, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
6,007ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Chile. Train it until it feels boring.
Base fitness for GFNY Chile. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
6,007ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at GFNY Chile. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on brutal paved rollers with wine valley stunners can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
The aerobic base that lets you ride brutal paved rollers with wine valley stunners at tempo for 79 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.

race_overlay.heat: September in Casablanca, Valparaíso Region, Chile can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before GFNY Chile. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for GFNY Chile's 79 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at GFNY Chile. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at GFNY Chile rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on brutal paved rollers with wine valley stunners to build confidence.
